function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread with iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotion. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart social thriller that mixes horror with sharp satire. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight nightmare—unsettling rituals set against a bright Swedish summer. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | An inventive premise where a curse follows you forever. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Tension built on silence; a fresh take on survival horror. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation with plenty of jump scares. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | 1977 | Dario Argento | Classic giallo with vivid colors and a haunting score. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | Slow‑burn dread rooted in Puritan folklore. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a slow‑burn psychological scare or a fast‑paced jump‑saw experience!
